Community outreach

Health starts
with all of us.

Education, screening, and shared support help our community take an active role in health and wellness.

Health education workshops

Workshops cover nutrition, exercise, and disease prevention to encourage healthy lifestyles and informed decisions.

Screening events

The center’s outreach includes screenings for conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, and cancer, creating opportunities for early detection and intervention.

Support groups

Groups offer space to share experiences and receive emotional support from others facing similar challenges.
